About the clinic

A neighbourhood clinic that treats you like family

Capital Dental Clinic is a friendly, full-service dental practice in G-11 Markaz, Islamabad. We care for patients of all ages — from a child's first check-up to complete restorative work for adults — with a calm, unhurried approach that puts nervous patients at ease.

Every visit starts with listening. We examine carefully, explain your options in plain words, and agree on a treatment plan together before any work begins — no surprises, and no treatment you don't need.

  • Sterile, modern equipment and a spotless treatment environment
  • Unhurried appointments — your questions answered before treatment starts
  • Honest advice: we recommend only the treatment your teeth actually need

What we do

Complete dental care under one roof

From everyday check-ups to advanced restorative work, our team covers the treatments most families need. Call us for consultation rates and to find the right treatment for you.

General Dentistry

Complete oral examinations, digital assessment, fillings, extractions and ongoing preventive care to keep your teeth and gums healthy year-round. The foundation of every healthy smile starts with a thorough check-up.

Call for consultation rates

Cleaning & Whitening

Professional scaling and polishing removes plaque, tartar and surface stains, while our whitening treatments safely lift the shade of your teeth for a fresher, brighter smile — often in a single visit.

Call for consultation rates

Braces & Orthodontics

Straighten crowded, spaced or misaligned teeth with orthodontic treatment planned around your bite, your age and your lifestyle. We will assess your case, explain the timeline honestly, and guide you through every adjustment until the braces come off.

Call for consultation rates

Dental Implants

Replace missing teeth with implants that look, feel and work like your own. Implants restore comfortable chewing and a natural smile without relying on neighbouring teeth. Book a consultation to check whether implants are right for you.

Call for consultation rates
